title: Ring of Elemental Infusion

sources.title: Elemental Infusion
markers: Until the end of your next turn

summary: Spell damage can infuse your next weapon hit with an extra 1d4 elemental damage.

fields.Elemental Infusion: Deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage using a spell or cantrip. Until the end of your next turn, your first successful weapon attack deals an extra 1d4 of that type. Only one infusion at a time. Priority from highest to lowest is Thunder, Lightning, Fire, Cold, Acid. The linked source reports multiple rider applications can occur on one attack.
fields.Acquisition: Gish Umr’a’ac in the south of the infirmary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
